author: PC Gamer
text:
Less than a week after launch, The Blood of Dawnwalker developer is already getting to work on the sequel
Rebel Wolves is hiring.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Thousand Hells is a 'tactical narrative' feast of infernal storytelling, but its defeats can feel brutal
From the developer of King of Dragon Pass, a gorgeously imagined meat grinder for hapless adventuring parties.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Inspired by the success of games like Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, French president Emmanuel Macron declares 'videogames are part of our culture' and announces a new international gaming festival
It seems like Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 really made an impact on Macron.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Breaking Benjamin frontman pauses concert to rant about Fallout 4 modding beef: 'There was a modder in the community that was really mean to me'
The singer and guitarist spent several minutes asking fans to download his Fallout 4 'True First Person' mod after another modder criticized it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Just days after The Tetris Company warned that 'we take copyright infringement very seriously,' the Tetris clone in the White House Arcade suddenly disappears
Maybe it's a coincidence, and maybe it's not.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Over 1,000 cut voice lines from Resident Evil 4 and Requiem reveal more about Leon Kennedy, the zombies he fights, and a lowkey bromance
We also got some hints to how later games are linked to Resident Evil 4.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Final Fantasy 14: Dawntrail's final story patch is exactly what the game needed, and has the 4-month wait for Evercold suddenly feeling a whole lot longer
Setting the stage to perfection.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Our absolute favourite gaming keyboard, the Wooting 80HE, is getting a BIG KNOB, improved switches, and more
This could become the new best gaming keyboard.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I got my hands on Razer's new $50 mechanical mini keeb and it makes a damn good first impression
It's got an entry-level MSRP, but still feels like an enthusiast-level device.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Why does this sort of thing never happen to me? Redditor says they found $10,000 worth of RAM just sitting in their garage
This memory stash doesn't grant an automatic upgrade for their gaming rig, though.

author: PC Gamer
text:
New RTX 5070 variant could help bolster GPU supply but it surely won't help prices
Nvidia is reportedly prepping a new version of the RTX 5070 potentially using failed RTX 5070 Ti or RTX 5080 cores.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Skyrim co-lead says Bethesda making Starfield instead of TES6 came out of nowhere: 'It was very much: Guess what, team? We're making this space game'
"It wasn't like Starfield was this big internal like, 'Hey, we all want to make this space game, Todd.'"

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valheim 1.0 review
Your long journey is at an end, Viking.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Chinese memory makers have reportedly stocked up on enough western DUV machines for the next three years of expansion
More chips!

author: PC Gamer
text:
SteelSeries throws everything but the kitchen sink in the feature list of its Aeon Pro controller
It can seamlessly switch between Xbox and PC, but is very expensive.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Sources say another 10% price increase for Intel CPUs is on the way, and it could be here as soon as October
Up, up, and away.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Don't Nod might not have enough cash to make it through January 2027, and even if it does, pulling up could 'involve the reduction of up to 90 positions'
"Amid systemic pressures in the video game industry."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Arc Raiders' last live update until Frozen Trails releases today bringing players new rubber ducks and a reminder that you've one month to spend your expiring currency
There's also a new Raider Project to fill the time with.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Big chipmakers are already committed to using ASML's next-generation production technology by as soon as 2028
High NA EUV and even 12-inch photomasks.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve appears to implementing a reservation system for the Steam Frame, suggesting it expects demand will outstrip supply at launch
Closer than you think.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Persona 1 and 2 remakes are something Atlus will 'probably eventually do', which is great, but the PS2-era Shin Megami Tensei games are sitting right there
Prioritize what I in particular want first, please Atlus.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6's Criminal Profile system sounds pretty interesting, includes a 'shattered' state for players who DGAF
There are reportedly four main states, Professional, Aggressive, Violent, and Psycho, plus a hard-to-reach state you can't come back from.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Capcom expresses continued interest in 're-activating IPs' as the first new Onimusha game in 20 years surpasses 1 million sales on launch day
Onimusha: Way of the Sword's launch day success has propelled the series to 10 million lifetime sales, says Capcom.
